title: Verxz Anti Lag
description: Lightweight lag cleaner plugin that removes items, arrows, and XP orbs to improve server performance.
body:
# 🧹 Verxz Anti Lag v1.1.0

Verxz Anti Lag is a lightweight and simple Minecraft server optimization plugin designed to help reduce unnecessary lag by removing unwanted entities and giving server owners better control over their server performance.

Originally created for my own server to fix lag problems, then shared so other server owners can improve their server experience too.

## ✨ Features

### 🧹 Entity Cleanup System
- Remove unnecessary entities with a simple command
- Cleans:
  - Dropped Items
  - Arrows
  - Experience Orbs

### 📊 Entity Status System
- Check your current server entity count
- Helps monitor possible lag sources

### 🛠️ Commands

**/antilag**
- Shows Verxz Anti Lag information

**/antilag cleanup**
- Removes unwanted entities manually

**/antilag status**
- Shows current entity count

**/antilag reload**
- Reloads the plugin configuration

## 🔐 Permissions

- `antilag.cleanup`
- `antilag.status`
- `antilag.reload`

## 🧩 PlaceholderAPI Support

Verxz Anti Lag v1.1.0 supports PlaceholderAPI.

Available placeholders:

- `%verxzantilag_status%`
- `%verxzantilag_removed%`

Works with:
- TAB
- Scoreboards
- Holograms
- Other PlaceholderAPI supported plugins

## ⚙️ Compatibility

Supported:
- Paper Servers
- Minecraft 1.21.x

## 🚀 v1.1.0 Update

Added:
- ✅ PlaceholderAPI Expansion
- ✅ Manual Cleanup Command
- ✅ Entity Status Command
- ✅ Reload Command
- ✅ Permission System
- ✅ Improved Plugin Structure
- ✅ Better Admin Controls

## 💡 About Verxz Anti Lag

A simple, lightweight and easy-to-use anti lag solution for Minecraft servers.

No unnecessary complicated systems — only useful tools to help keep your server cleaner, smoother, and easier to manage.
